segments.name: Edge cloud platform
segments.description: Provides an integrated edge cloud platform for organizations of all sizes, delivering content, security and compute solutions at the edge of the internet.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable and operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription and committed usage fees for security subscription services and committed edge cloud platform usage.
revenueModel.evidence: Deferred revenue primarily consists of the unearned portions of billings for the Company's security subscription services and the unearned portion of committed edge cloud platform usage.
